heading: Life Beyond the Classroom.
subheading: A dynamic campus environment where students discover their talents, build lifelong friendships, and celebrate milestones.
notice: Activity schedules and club memberships are announced at the beginning of each academic semester.

activities.title: Annual Cultural Celebrations
activities.description: Showcasing music, regional dance forms, drama, and artistic expression celebrating cultural diversity.

activities.title: Debate & General Knowledge Forum
activities.description: Weekly inter-class debates, current affairs quiz leagues, and parliamentary style mock deliberations.

activities.title: Science & Innovation Exposition
activities.description: Student-designed working models, chemistry demos, and mathematical exhibitions presenting creative solutions.

activities.title: Annual Athletic Meet & Games
activities.description: Inter-house sports tournaments, track events, and team finals celebrated with campus-wide enthusiasm.

activities.title: Youth Leadership Seminars
activities.description: Interactive sessions with inspiring guest educators focusing on career pathways and personal motivation.
